events.title: 🛠️ Dev Update: Why It’s Taking Longer & What We Are Building
events.summary: Hi everyone,We know we’ve been a bit quiet lately, and updates are taking longer than usual to roll out. We want to be completely transparent with you about why this is happening and what’s going on behind the scenes.Lately, our team has been facing limited free time coupled with a massive workload. Instead of just releasing small, temporary fixes, we decided to take a step back and dedicate our energy to a massive overhaul to make the game smoother, more stable, and significantly more playable.

events.title: HotFix 0.0.6A
events.summary: The text for the toys category in the toys section, which was showing "????" instead of the correct name, has been corrected.Fixed a bug where the "buy all toys" achievement wouldn't unlock.Fix a synchronization error where products placed on the shelf did not appear when the game was restarted.Daily statistics menu for each store will not open.The day and night system, and its visual and sound effects, have been optimized.
